activity.notes: Razia Sultan (Raziyyat al-Din) ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1236 to 1240. The record represents her sovereign reign as Sultan of Delhi at year granularity.

sources.title: 1200-1300 — Razia Sultan
sources.citation_text: Shahjahanabad Redevelopment Corporation, Government of Delhi: Razia succeeded to the Sultanate of Delhi in 1236 and ruled from 1236 to 1240.

sources.title: Razia Sultan of India: Queen of the World Bilqis-i Jihan
sources.citation_text: Cambridge University Press, The Unforgettable Queens of Islam, chapter 4: Razia became the first and only female sultan of the Delhi Sultanate and ruled a little over three years.
